video_title: Breaking Down My Brand New 3 Year Adidas Contract As An NBA Player!

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Clarifying misconceptions about NBA player shoe contracts and compensation
quotes.excerpt: we sign a contract, Adidas gives us millions of dollars and everything. Deals like that are more for your superstars
quotes.quote: Unlike what many of you guys think, we sign a contract, Adidas gives us millions of dollars and everything. Deals like that are more for your superstars, which would be like Anthony Edwards, James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, any guy you can think of that has their own shoe. If they have their own shoe, they are probably getting a money deal or if they are a higher-end player, they probably have some money involved. Guys like me on the bench and don't play or average 20, 25 or whatever, we have milestones we have to meet in order to get paid X amount of dollars.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Explaining how NBA shoe contract tiers and performance incentives work
quotes.excerpt: if you play in a certain amount of games, when you are on a tier one team
quotes.quote: One of these tiers is literally just the city you play in. If you play in, they have like tier one, tier two, tier three. I am just going to give you tier one because everybody would know it: New York, LA, Texas. If you play in that region, they qualify those as tier one teams and normally those are teams with the most TV games. So if you play a certain amount of games when you are on a tier one team, then they give you money. Another way to make money is if you lead the league in steals, lead the league in points.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of social media growth on NBA endorsement deals
quotes.excerpt: if you can grow your brand or your channel or your Instagram page within a certain amount
quotes.quote: Also, social media actually, if you can grow your brand or your channel or your Instagram page within a certain amount to a certain amount of volume within the period of being signed, that also does bring very lucrative offers from Adidas that incentivize you to keep building your pages and brands. That is why a lot of these guys have managers and people that run their stuff.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Distinguishing between endorsement allotment and gifted player gear
quotes.excerpt: my rep sends me shoes, that doesn't count against my allotment. My allotment only counts against me
quotes.quote: One big thing when you sign a shoe contract, at least for Adidas, not me. So if my rep sends me shoes, that doesn't count against my allotment. My allotment only counts against me when I buy my own stuff on adidas.com or wherever. That is when the stuff actually counts against me. But them sending me shoes like this or like this or whatever, that doesn't come out, come against me.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: The exclusivity requirements of NBA player shoe endorsement deals
quotes.excerpt: you can't wear Nike, Puma, Reebok, anything. Actually, one I didn't know and I borderline got in trouble
quotes.quote: The only thing when you sign an endorsement deal with an Adidas, obviously you know, you can't wear Nike, Puma, Reebok, anything. Actually, one I didn't know and I borderline got in trouble with is I wore some Alo. I wore a Alo jumpsuit before the game and shout out my boy Miles. Yeah, shout out my boy Miles, he had to hit me, they had to hit me before the games like, 'Yeah, Alo is a brand competitor, you can't wear that.' So that is the only thing I would say, if you are going to pick a brand, pick a brand you actually like to wear.
